recipe:
set -e
x=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/baseline/catalog_processing/xi_scan/xi_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $x
c=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/baseline/covariances/cov_scan/cov_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $c
ver=$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/catalog_versions.py size_cut applied --scan-version SP_v1.4.8_leak_corr)
cb=covariance_"$ver"_A_integration
python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/compute_cosebis_pte_single.py \
  --reporting-binning bins_20 --integration-grid bins_1000 --mode-count n_max_20 \
  --xi-integration "$x/$ver"_xi_minsep=0.5_maxsep=300.0_nbins=1000_npatch=1.txt \
  --cov-integration "$c/$cb/$cb"_processed.txt \
  --version $ver --blind blind_a \
  --out-file results/baseline/significance/cosebis_pte_scan/cosebis_ptes_sp_v1p4p8_leak_corr.npz
rm -rf "$x" "$c"
